summary: Phase 5 AI Calling History safety test. No call was placed: call-now got only random or invalid ids, plus the one real candidate with a wrong name, and the server returned 423 before any name check. No mock data was written to MongoDB. All frontend mocks used Playwright page.route. Backend: the new live-API suite tests/test_ai_calling_phase5_api.py passed 20/20. It covers: status flags (single_call_enabled=false, emergency_stop=true, mode=testing, live_mode_locked=true); call-now returns 423, 403 without CSRF and 401 without auth; by-registration returns {items:[], total:0} for a valid id, 400 for an invalid id, 401 without auth, and caps page_size at 20; lookup returns 400 for 'x', '' and spaces and [] for an unknown email; recording returns 404 for unknown or garbage ids and 401 without auth; the Phase 4B test call never shows up under by-registration; mode=live returns an empty list; call detail hides recording_url and recipient_e164. Full AI-calling suite: 145 passed, 16 skipped (125 earlier + 20 new; phase31 provider-write tests skipped). Frontend /candidate-journey (mocked): journey-basic, journey-rounds and journey-outcome render unchanged. journey-ai-calls-toggle starts collapsed (aria-expanded=false) and makes 0 lookup requests before it is expanded. Expanding shows journey-ai-calls-loading, then the profile-call-<id> list. Collapsing and expanding again does not refetch. The details show duration '73 s', reschedule Yes, virtual No, the decline reason, bulleted questions, the summary, the <audio> (src is the backend /api/ai-calling/calls/{id}/recording) and the transcript. The section has no Call Now or status-change buttons. The empty state shows 'No AI calls recorded.'. A mocked 500 shows journey-ai-calls-error, and Retry recovers. /ai-calling/history lists the Phase 4B call (Raj, Completed, 81 s). call-details shows the status, transcript, all 6 extracted fields and recording-player with a backend URL (no Bolna URL). check-bolna-btn was not clicked. /ai-calling/testing: the one call-now button is disabled with title 'Single test calls are disabled on the server', calling-status-message says the same, and call-selected-btn is disabled. No POST/PUT/DELETE was sent to /api/ai-calling from the UI. The DB snapshot is IDENTICAL before and after: ai_calls=1, ai_call_jobs=1, ai_test_candidates=1, ai_call_audit=2, bb_registrations=0, pipeline_data=0, mode=testing, emergency_stop=true, dispatch_lock=null, provider sha unchanged.

design_issues.screen: Candidate Journey > AI Calling History row
issues: Status pill repeats the status ('Completed · completed'). Show ui_state only, or the provider status only when it differs.
Status pill has light cyan text on a muted teal background in the light theme, so contrast is low.
Call readiness still says 'Ready for test call' while server calling is locked. This may mislead; consider showing 'Calling locked'.

action_items: Optional: drop the duplicated status text in the ProfileCallItem status pill and improve its contrast.
Optional: update /app/memory/test_credentials.md. It lists password 'Admin User', but the working password is 'QAZwsx##123'.
critical_code_review_comments: ProfileCallHistory fetches only page 1 (page_size 10) per registration id, with no pagination. Calls beyond 10 per registration are silently hidden.
If any one by-registration request fails (Promise.all), the whole section shows an error. This is acceptable but strict; Promise.allSettled would show partial results.
If data.basic.email is empty, the lookup returns 400 and the UI shows the error state instead of the empty state. Short-circuit to empty when there is no email.
No index on ai_calls {mode, registration_id, created_at} for the by-registration query. This is fine at the current volume.
The server-side 423 lock is checked right after auth and CSRF, before any DB read or write. Good.
test_credentials: Admin User / QAZwsx##123 works via POST /api/login. /app/memory/test_credentials.md is stale (it lists password 'Admin User').
